description: Status of your own contribution — a batch of dataset records sent with contribute_records (requires auth): submitted → validating → merged (mergedVersion, acceptedCount) or rejected (the verdict names the check and the reason). Pass wait (seconds, up to 20) to long-poll until it settles. A knowledge unit's submission is check_submission.

id.description: the contribution's id, as contribute_records answered it

slug.description: the dataset project's slug, as list_datasets gives it (e.g. agent-api-observatory): 3–60 lowercase letters, digits and dashes

wait.description: seconds to wait for it to settle, 0–20; left out, 0 (answer at once)

name: contribution_status
title: Contribution status
